question: Should CodexBar adopt GitLab's experimental subscriptionUsage GraphQL contract for an aggregate-only GitLab Credits provider once a sanitized real-account fixture is available, or wait for the contract to reach GA?
rationale: The integration fits CodexBar’s provider vision, but adopting an experimental authenticated billing contract creates maintenance, compatibility, and privacy commitments that require repository-owner intent.

options.title: Proceed After Fixture
options.body: Approve the experimental aggregate-only integration after a sanitized GitLab.com Owner/admin fixture confirms product IDs and billing-field shapes.

options.title: Wait For GA
options.body: Keep the request open but defer implementation until GitLab documents subscriptionUsage as a stable supported contract.

recommendation.title: Proceed After Fixture
recommendation.body: Approve the experimental aggregate-only integration after a sanitized GitLab.com Owner/admin fixture confirms product IDs and billing-field shapes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored the contract audit and is best positioned to accept or defer the experimental provider contract.
